ground_truth.basis: Renaming a run does not create a new budget root. Trials belong to the budget root, and a continuation under the same condition inherits the parent budget root. Retries are counted attempts with no reset, and search counters are never refunded. Treating a rename as a reset is exactly the search-budget escape the design forbids; the additional trials would inflate the effective independent trial count and corrupt any multiple-testing correction.
